## 4. Mappings in their iFlow (steps before and after)
Read from the `.iflw` files in `_reference/iflows/`. **Before / After** list only the steps on a path into / out of the mapping step (other gateway branches are left out), in flow order. A message mapping is linked by name to its `.mmap` (also to a standalone export of the same name).
